crossRefs.note: In the morning sow your seed, and in the evening don’t withhold your hand; for you don’t know which will prosper…
Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,
But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought…
Though a sinner commits crimes a hundred times, and lives long, yet surely I know that it will be better with those who…
This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of…
What man is he who fears Yahweh? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.
He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.
Yahweh preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.
I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from following them, to do them good. I will…
But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out, and leap…
His mercy is for generations of generations on those who fear him.

translations.web: It is good that you should take hold of this. Yes, also don’t withdraw your hand from that; for he who fears God will come out of them all.
translations.bsb: It is good to grasp the one and not let the other slip from your hand. For he who fears God will follow both warnings.
translations.kjv: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this; yea, also from this withdraw not thine hand: for he that feareth God shall come forth
translations.asv: It is good that thou shouldest take hold of this; yea, also from that withdraw not thy hand: for he that feareth God shall come forth from them all.
